properties.DESCRIPTION:
Most 3 bhk farmhouses in these gated societies are designed as luxury cottages or modern villas.
Built-Up area: Generally ranges from 2,500 to 4,500 sq. Ft.
Layout: Spacious living and dining areas, modular kitchens, and en-Suite bathrooms. Many include a separate servant room and large deck areas. 
Private amenities: A private swimming pool, manicured lawns, and gazebo areas are standard in "ready-To-Move" premium units.
2. Gated community benefits
Security: 24/7 multi-Tier security with cctv surveillance and gated entry/exit points. 
Infrastructure: Wide black-Top internal roads (Typically 33 ft to 66 ft wide), street lighting, and underground electricity cabling.
Water & power: Dedicated borewells (Sweet water) and power backup facilities.
3. Location advantages
Connectivity: Strategic access via the delhi-Mumbai expressway (Ne-4) and the sohna-Gurgaon elevated road, making the drive from golf course extension road roughly 20-30 minutes. 

Environment: Located in the foothills of the aravalis, offering a "zero pollution" zone compared to central gurugram.
Proximity: Close to the westin sohna resort & spa, providing high resale value and rental potential for weekend stays.
Investment considerations
Registry & mutation: Ensure the land has a clear title and is eligible for registry and mutation (Dakhil-Kharij).
Construction stage: You can find both "ready-To-Move" fully furnished farmhouses and "raw plots" where you can build according to your own 3 bhk floor plan.
Price trends: Prices in the sohna region have seen an appreciation of 15-20% annually due to the massive infrastructure development around the kmp expressway and the delhi-Mumbai corridor.

Any details contact us

properties.DESCRIPTION:
Vatika westin farms is a premium gated community in sohna , gurgaon featuring approved freehold plots designed for luxury , ready to move farmhouses. Located adjacent to the westin sohna resort & spa , these fully developed , lush green spaces offer private , eco friendly living with modern utilities in a secure , high end environment.

* location - Situated in sector 35/sohna road ,gurgaon , offering a tranquil environment away from city chaos , yet accessible.

* infrastructure - Typically offers 1 acre plot sizes ( Or approx. 1200, 2400-3600+sq.Yards), many featuring four sided boundary walls , security , wide roads and ready electricity/water connections.

* lifestyles - Designed for high - End buyers , offering amenities like landscaped gardens , private swimming pools , gazebos, staff quarters, and proximity to organic farming opportunities. 

* security & environment - A gated community featuring 24*7 security and cctv, set within 37+ acres of green , low - Pollution surroundings ( Often cited with 40 - 50 ppm levels ).

* developer - Developed by vatika limited, providing a secure , managed and prestigious neighborhood.

formatted.desc:
Vatika westin farms is a premium gated community in sohna , gurgaon featuring approved freehold plots designed for luxury , ready to move farmhouses. Located adjacent to the westin sohna resort & spa , these fully developed , lush green spaces offer private , eco friendly living with modern utilities in a secure , high end environment.

* location - Situated in sector 35/sohna road ,gurgaon , offering a tranquil environment away from city chaos , yet accessible.

* infrastructure - Typically offers 1 acre plot sizes ( Or approx. 1200, 2400-3600+sq.Yards), many featuring four sided boundary walls , security , wide roads and ready electricity/water connections.

* lifestyles - Designed for high - End buyers , offering amenities like landscaped gardens , private swimming pools , gazebos, staff quarters, and proximity to organic farming opportunities. 

* security & environment - A gated community featuring 24*7 security and cctv, set within 37+ acres of green , low - Pollution surroundings ( Often cited with 40 - 50 ppm levels ).

* developer - Developed by vatika limited, providing a secure , managed and prestigious neighborhood.
